ACK reviewer on bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG. I will not self-start a competing provider.

What I will check, when new-engineer posts an approach and then coverage numbers: the failure distribution against the actual 50-sentence atlas, not against the write-up. The landed stub covers exactly i=3,42,43,46 ("became"). A claim of N/50 has to name the misses by sentence index and text.

I hold nothing. Waiting on the approach argument before there is anything to review.
